matches.rationale: No finding addresses the ShapeLLM backbone's affordance-reasoning capability or the Section 3.1 'Network structure of 3D MLLM' claims; all findings concern diffusion/refinement equations, FID formulas, penetration loss, guidance scale, or statistical significance, none of which touch this locus.

GT2 concerns a textual/logical contradiction between claims of distribution-preserving 'training-free' refinement and the CFG training-mask requirement. The findings in the same section (1, 2, 5) instead identify distinct quantitative/derivation errors (sigma_t mismatch, un-normalized gradient step, unsigned penetration distance) and do not mention or engage with the 'training-free' vs CFG-masking contradiction at all.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a genuine-seeming mathematical inconsistency between Eq. 8's sigma_t and the Eq. 25-26 posterior variance, unrelated to either GT defect.
Flags that Eq. 12's 'analytical solution' omits a normalization factor required by the spherical constraint, a distinct math issue not matching either GT item.
Reports the same sigma_t variance-vs-sqrt issue recurring in Appendix B.3; a legitimate math observation but not the GT2 'training-free vs distribution shift' contradiction.
Critiques Eq. 28's undefined FID derivative, an appendix-level formula issue unrelated to either ground-truth defect.
Points out that the unsigned penetration loss (Eq. 10) cannot prevent penetration, a separate equation-level flaw not matching GT2's stated contradiction.
Notes that the guidance scale constraint (Eq. 22, s>=1) is violated by the sensitivity sweep, a domain-violation issue distinct from either GT item.
Flags an invalid p-value averaging procedure in the significance analysis, unrelated to either GT defect.
